audit_notes: Parameters physical. A loose glass microfibre mat in a dusty hot climate will trap dust in its interstices and rain rarely cleans it; I raise the 20-year mean absorptance from 0.15 to 0.18 (SR 0.82 aged mean). Emittance of a glass-fibre layer on a mineral base ~0.93 (silica reststrahlen near 9 um partly offset by fibre scattering); set 0.93. Size parameter of fibres x = pi*d/lambda = pi*8e-6/0.5e-6 ~ 50 (geometric-optics/TIR regime in the visible; Mie in the NIR). Biot of envelope wall_conductance/h_o = 0.026. Simulation coefficient: effective sol-air excess (alpha*I - eps*dR)/h_o = (108-74.4)/20 = 1.68 K. Model: steady 1D conduction, linear, analytical. Metric: heat flux to the room at x=1. Baseline: aged cool paint alpha 0.32, eps 0.90. Roof case. Expected gain ~23%. Mechanical: glass fibres are brittle; hail and sand abrasion break them; bonding to the base must survive 40 K cycles. Durability risk, not a safety risk; audit passed.
